recognize_zh: 在大致正常的紅血球之間，可見少數小而染色較深、有直線切緣或尖角的紅血球碎片，以及一側被切平的頭盔狀細胞（helmet cells），符合裂紅血球（schistocytes）。
features: Scattered small, dense red cell fragments with straight edges and angular points
Occasional helmet-shaped cells with one flattened, cut border
Fragments are fewer than intact cells; most red cells are normocytic discocytes with central pallor
Platelets appear sparse in this field
No agglutination, nucleated red cells or leukocytes seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered schistocytes, including small angular fragments and helmet-shaped cells with straight cut edges. Platelets appear sparse in the field. No spherocyte predominance, agglutination or inclusions are seen. Findings are consistent with schistocytes; a count of more than about 1% of red cells in an appropriate setting supports microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (TTP, HUS, DIC) or mechanical hemolysis, and should be correlated with platelet count and hemolysis markers.

ddx.vs: Bite cells are intact cells with a rounded bite-like defect, not small fragments with straight edges and sharp corners.
Artifact produces fragments mainly at the feathered edge or near crushed cells, whereas true schistocytes are distributed in the evaluable monolayer.
Microspherocytes are small but round and smooth-contoured, lacking the angular cut edges of schistocytes.
